title: Days and weeks
goal: Name the days of the week, say what you do on which day, and how often.
tip: Every day of the week ends in વાર: સોમવાર, મંગળવાર. Add એ for "on": સોમવારે = on Monday. How-often words like રોજ (every day) and ક્યારેક (sometimes) go near the start: હું રોજ ચા પીઉં છું.

items.notes: Also means "time" as in once or twice: બે વાર, twice.
Each day is named after a heavenly body: સોમ is the moon.

alts: Which day is it today
What day is today
items.notes: વાર is masculine, so કયો, not કયું.
રવિ is the sun, which is also why રવિ is a boy's name.

alts: It is Sunday today
It's Sunday today

items.english: On Monday I go to school.
alts: I go to school on Monday
On Mondays I go to school
I go to school on Mondays

items.english: On Saturdays we go to the temple.
alts: We go to the temple on Saturdays
On Saturday we go to the temple
We go to the temple on Saturday

items.notes: In everyday talk people use the English names of the months: જાન્યુઆરી, ફેબ્રુઆરી, માર્ચ.

alts: What's the date today
What date is it today
Which date is it today
items.notes: You'll hear આજે કેટલી તારીખ છે? (how many-th?) just as often.

alts: It is the tenth today
Today is the 10th
items.notes: Just the number and તારીખ. You'll also hear દસમી તારીખ, the tenth date.

items.english: There are seven days in a week.
alts: A week has seven days
items.notes: હોય છે is "is" for things that are always true. Before માં, અઠવાડિયું changes to અઠવાડિયા.
ક્યારેય નથી or ક્યારેય નહીં = never.

items.english: I sometimes go to the temple.
alts: Sometimes I go to the temple

items.gujarati: દાદા હંમેશાં સવારે ચા પીએ છે.
items.translit: daadaa hammeshaan savaare chaa piye chhe.
items.english: Grandpa always drinks tea in the morning.
alts: Grandpa always has tea in the morning
Grandfather always drinks tea in the morning

items.english: I never eat meat (a man speaking).
alts: I never eat meat
I do not ever eat meat
items.notes: A woman says હું ક્યારેય માંસ નથી ખાતી.

items.gujarati: રવિવારે આખો પરિવાર ઘરે હોય છે.
items.translit: ravivaare aakho parivaar ghare hoy chhe.
items.english: On Sundays the whole family is at home.
alts: The whole family is at home on Sundays
On Sunday the whole family is at home
items.notes: આખો (whole) agrees with પરિવાર, which is masculine.

alts: Every day I learn Gujarati
I am learning Gujarati every day

items.gujarati: શુક્રવારે સાંજે અમે બજાર જઈએ છીએ.
items.translit: shukravaare saanje ame bajaar jaiye chhiye.
items.english: On Friday evenings we go to the market.
alts: We go to the market on Friday evenings
On Friday evening we go to the market
Mum never drinks tea
Mom doesn't ever drink tea
